messages:
Alyssa: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `enable_shared_prefix_cache` today in quiet window at 23:00 UTC. Owner: @matt. Can someone be on standby for 30m? :wave:

Matt: I'll own. I'll do canary -> 5% for 10m then 50% then 100% if green. Ping me in thread for CRs.

Lauren: Do we have safe-defaults set? Should be `false` if any issue. Confirming toggle will default to off for unknown tenants.

Jin: Safe default is enforced by the gating layer but remind: set `flag-default=false` in rollout config. Also we should enable `auto-fallback=true` so requests go to baseline model if route fails.

SRE-Oncall: I can watch logs. What are the smoke checks? Any specific traces or metrics?

Alyssa: Smoke checklist: 1) 200 OK rate >99% on /v1/generate; 2) median p90 latency <= 350ms; 3) error budget burn <= 0.2%. I'll run these queries: 
```bash
# smoke: synthetic call
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status'
```

Matt: Also I'll watch KV cache hit rate and mem usage. If any of these fail, immediate rollback to `commit: v2.4.1` and set flag back to false. Rollback command:
```bash
redwoodctl flags set enable_shared_prefix_cache false --commit v2.4.1
```

devops-bot: Scheduled rollout by @matt at 2024-09-15T23:00:00Z — canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m pauses. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/flag-rollout

Lauren: CR review ping @matt — I left one small comment on the toggle PR about metric tags. :mag:

Matt: Thanks — fixing now, will post update before flip. :thumbsup:

Alyssa: OK. If no objections, we'll proceed. If you can't be on call, say so now.

Chris: I can pair on rollback if needed, available from 22:30-00:30 UTC.

Alyssa: Perfect. I'll post start/finish timestamps here. Thanks team.
